problem:
If $A={8,9}$ and $B={x,y},$ which of the following elements belong to $A\times B\times A?$

- $(9,9,y)$
- $(8,x,y)$
- $(9,y,8)$
worked_solution:
The Cartesian product $A\times B\times C$ consists of all ordered triples whose first coordinate belongs to $A,$ second coordinate belongs to $B,$ and the third coordinate belongs to $C.$

In this case, $A\times B\times A$ consists of every combination of ${8,9}$ with ${x,y}$ and ${8,9},$ which results in

$$
\begin{aligned}A\times B\times A={ & (8,x,8),(8,x,9),(8,y,8),(8,y,9), \\  & (9,x,8),(9,x,9),(9,y,8),(9,y,9)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Note that

$$
|A\times B\times A|=|A|\cdot |B|\cdot |A|=2\cdot 2\cdot 2=8.
$$

From the given options, we see that only $(9,y,8)\in A\times B\times A.$

Therefore, the correct answer is "III only."
